subject: Confirming 75m ML/Infra deep-dive — proposed windows & attendee gaps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Anna Garcia <anna@novaforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming 75m ML/Infra deep-dive — proposed windows & attendee gaps

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: Novaforge is evaluating a hosted + dedicated hybrid for inference, with primary constraints around predictable latency for production workloads, and a need to understand how model quantization and batching will affect cost/SLOs. You mentioned wanting a technical session focused on serving architecture, capacity planning, and a short ops handoff — ideal for a 60–90 minute deep-dive.

To make scheduling easy, can you confirm which of these windows works for your team (all times PDT):
- Thu Apr 8, 10:00–11:15 (75m) PDT
- Tue Apr 13, 08:30–09:45 (75m) PDT
- Wed Apr 14, 13:00–14:15 (75m) PDT

Attendee ask from our side: we recommend having (1) your ML lead, (2) an infra/SRE contact, and (3) the product owner who owns latency/SLAs. On our side I’ll bring Marissa (solutions lead) and Karthik (serving/runtime). If you confirm a preferred window I’ll lock a 75-minute slot and circulate a short agenda and pre-read.

Attaching a first-pass agenda (attachment stub). If you have any specific runbooks or workloads you want us to prioritize, paste links here and we’ll slot them into the run-of-show.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Vivek —

Thanks, that all looks good. Preferred is Thu Apr 8, 10:00–11:15 PDT.

Roster from our side (so you can loop folks in):
- Anna Garcia — Chief Data Officer — anna@novaforge.com
- Sam Patel — Head of ML (will present model details) — sam@novaforge.com
- Leah Wong — Infra lead (to confirm availability) — leah.wong@novaforge.com

We’ll try to get Leah on the call; if she can’t make it we’ll have a backup SRE (TBD). Please include a 10–15 minute Q&A at the end for runbook/ops questions. Also appreciate a short pre-read — any pointers on what to share internally (logs, sample model size, expected RPS) would help us prepare.

Anna

Vivek / team —

Thanks — locking Apr 8 as the preferred window makes sense. A few quick notes from our side to make the session productive:

1) Attendee mapping:
- Karthik will cover serving/runtime decisions (kernel selection, quantization tradeoffs).
- I’ll run the demo and lead the ops handoff section.
- We should add an infra engineer to walk through network / GPU sizing; Marcus can cover that slot and he’s available at the Apr 8 time.

2) Pre-read request for Novaforge (send items 48 hours before):
- One representative model artifact (size & architecture)
- Estimated steady-state RPS and P95 latency targets
- Existing deployment topology (cloud regions, VPC peering notes)

3) Run-of-show (75m recommended):
- 0–10m: Goals & success criteria (both sides)
- 10–35m: Architecture & capacity discussion (Karthik + Sam)
- 35–55m: Live demo: 2 representative requests (Marissa)
- 55–65m: Ops handoff & rollout considerations (Marissa + Marcus)
- 65–75m: Q&A & next steps

Action: Vivek — can you confirm the calendar invite and share the agenda PDF + calendar link? I’ll follow up with Marcus to add any infra notes.

Marissa
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Great — Apr 8, 10:00–11:15 PDT (75m) is booked. I’ve sent a calendar invite (link below) to everyone on this thread; please accept when you can. Attendee roster from Redwood: Vivek (me), Marissa Cole (solutions lead), Karthik Iyer (serving/runtime), Marcus Lin (infra engineer).

Agenda (attached + quick bullets):
- Objectives & acceptance criteria (5–10m)
- Serving architecture & quantization options (Karthik)

Looking forward to it —
